usage: deskops runtime workers [-h] [--root ROOT] [--herdr HERDR]
                               [--format {text,json}]

List live Herdr agents across all workspaces on this machine.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --root ROOT           Target repository root.
  --herdr HERDR         Herdr executable.
  --format {text,json}  Output format.
